description: Use this when the person wants Pugi logos already shown in this conversation changed or redone: other colours (named or hex, for example "dark blue and mint, #112A46 and #14B8A6"), a calmer or bolder mood, another icon or font, "like the second one but blue". Works on the latest set, picked or not. Draws four new options from the same brief with that change, with no questions; it does not edit one chosen design. The set is named by one of logo_id (from a logo result) or question_token (from the logo card). A different business name is a new brand (make_logo).

change.description: The change in the person's own words, for example "make it blue and calmer" or "dark blue and mint (#112A46, #14B8A6)".

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this call, reused only to retry it.

language.description: The language the person writes in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

logo_id.description: One logo_id of the set to change, from a logo result (the picked one when there is one); the alternative to question_token.

question_token.description: The question_token of the logo card; the alternative to logo_id.

name: refine_logo
title: Change the logos
